method_design_and_unit: 16 purposive stakeholder interviews in EU and UK
what_procurement_evidence_supports: Interviewed accounts of routes into government AI: frameworks, pilots, software updates and embedded AI
what_postaward_evidence_supports: Participants report inadequate post-award monitoring and recommend continuing governance mechanisms
do_not_infer: No named signed contract, enforced vendor cure, or measured policy effect established

method_design_and_unit: 19 city staff in seven US cities
what_procurement_evidence_supports: Employees report procured AI systems and purchasing authority; no representative census of contracts
what_postaward_evidence_supports: Some interviewees report independently monitoring procured gunshot detection because vendor did not provide evaluation
do_not_infer: Interview reports do not independently authenticate signed clauses, supplier fault or causal outcome benefit

method_design_and_unit: Interviews and original GovAI FactSheet analysis, count not independently reaudited in R51
what_procurement_evidence_supports: FactSheets used by vendors for buyer evaluation, not contracts by themselves
what_postaward_evidence_supports: Voluntary disclosures may be incomplete; early-stage vendor-buyer dialogue is reported
do_not_infer: A marketing/disclosure form is not a signed SLA, audit exercise, or independent system validation

method_design_and_unit: 51 interviews, 57 observations, 166 documents at 10 imaging networks
what_procurement_evidence_supports: Evaluation reports dates for executed network/Trust procurement contracts in March, May and September 2024
what_postaward_evidence_supports: Observed governance meetings, supplier demonstration/training and post-award implementation planning
do_not_infer: Reported contract signatures are not original signed instruments, and governance meetings are not supplier sanctions

what_procurement_evidence_supports: Discusses NHS framework procurement and vendor qualification; contextual framework design
what_postaward_evidence_supports: Describes desired quality controls and post-market surveillance needs
do_not_infer: Proposed measures and reported NHS stroke uptake are not dated contractual enforcement

method_design_and_unit: Longitudinal predeployment public innovation procurement case
what_procurement_evidence_supports: AI-enabled architecture supports public housing design and procurement preparation
what_postaward_evidence_supports: Ex ante assessment and collaborative development of public housing system architecture
do_not_infer: Does NOT show public authority procured the AI as a distinct bought product, or post-award remediation

method_design_and_unit: Doctrinal/legal analysis of migration AI contracts and secrecy
what_procurement_evidence_supports: Examines procured/vendor-developed AI and statutory/private secrecy interacting
what_postaward_evidence_supports: Identifies contractual confidentiality and trade secrecy limits on accessing models
do_not_infer: Does not independently show a named buyer exercising a specific supplier sanction

method_design_and_unit: Legal doctrinal analysis of procurement legislation
what_procurement_evidence_supports: Explicitly discusses government acquiring AI AND government using AI in purchasing
what_postaward_evidence_supports: Suggests results-based SLA and transparency safeguards
do_not_infer: No documented exercised audit clause or supplier correction from an identified contract

what_procurement_evidence_supports: Respondents examine digital sourcing governance, AI risk perceptions and perceived supplier performance
what_postaward_evidence_supports: Reported association of risk awareness and perceived supplier performance
do_not_infer: Survey association does not verify actual contract sanction or causal remedy success

method_design_and_unit: Expert consultations and structural factor modeling
what_procurement_evidence_supports: Models critical success factors for procuring public sector AI systems
do_not_infer: Not evidence of executed procurement or supplier post-award remediation

method_design_and_unit: Survey of representatives of 28 Canadian municipal AI projects
what_procurement_evidence_supports: Compares choices to develop AI in-house or outsource technology
what_postaward_evidence_supports: Respondents identify supplier oversight/explainability and maintenance challenges
do_not_infer: 28 projects are not 28 signed external contracts, or measured vendor corrections

method_design_and_unit: Decommissioning survey: 5 of 40 reporting staff responded
what_procurement_evidence_supports: Tool withdrawn from an NHS radiology trust amid funding/contract context
what_postaward_evidence_supports: Reports postwithdrawal staff perceptions and proposed protocol
do_not_infer: Withdrawal does not establish supplier contractual default, sanction or independent patient benefit

method_design_and_unit: Original published public-health vendor proposal assessment
what_procurement_evidence_supports: 21 functional and six nonfunctional criteria applied to written vendor submissions for AutoML selection
what_postaward_evidence_supports: Panel scores vendors and shortlists solutions before contract award
do_not_infer: Selection does not establish executed contract, deployment or vendor cure

method_design_and_unit: Study of firm-level public-security facial-recognition procurements
what_procurement_evidence_supports: Empirical contract-level procurement source evidence linking state data and AI firms
what_postaward_evidence_supports: Assesses firms commercial innovation after data-rich contract awards
do_not_infer: Commercial innovation is not evidence of buyer oversight or public-service benefit

method_design_and_unit: Published risk/success-factor study, original method not yet audited
what_procurement_evidence_supports: Original title explicitly concerns public-sector AI procurement projects
what_postaward_evidence_supports: Source-text research candidates for risk factors, no evidenced remedy verified
do_not_infer: No actual signed contract, implemented oversight, or supplier outcome authenticated

method_design_and_unit: UK chapter from edited Buying AI volume
what_procurement_evidence_supports: Original chapter prospectus concerns AI procurement governance
what_postaward_evidence_supports: Legal framework rather than a measured intervention
do_not_infer: Chapter full text not accessed; should not infer case-level data or enforcement

method_design_and_unit: Legal study of 10 listed state procurement contract case rows with amendment history
what_procurement_evidence_supports: Author reads actual state contract text and amendments including Michigan and FraudCaster
what_postaward_evidence_supports: Discusses testing, IP access and operational disputes; selection informed by litigation complaints
do_not_infer: Author research is not independent reproduction of contracts by 99aI or population prevalence
